controls: Every persisted edge requires non-empty input and output ports, a string title, a positive version, and canonical ordered lifecycle timestamps.
Self-edges, duplicate directed pairs, and cycles are rejected independently of project index integrity.
Invalid graph state fails before atomic backup promotion and leaves no visible destination or staging residue.
limitations: Uses local synthetic SQLite fixtures only.
Does not claim an external backup, production restore, signing, retention, deployment, provider call, or authenticated LibTV action.
